How It Works

Simple steps to your perfect setup

01
Send Your Inquiry

Message us on WhatsApp, call, DM on Instagram or use the inquiry form below with your event date, location and vision.

02
Consult & Quote

We chat through your ideas and inspiration photos, then send a customised quotation based on your requirements.

03
Pay 70% to Secure

Your date is secured once the quotation is accepted and the 70% deposit is received. An inquiry alone does not confirm a booking.

04
Balance & Celebrate

The remaining 30% is due 72 hours before your event. Then we create the magic and you simply enjoy it.

FAQ

Good to know

How do I book?

Send an inquiry by WhatsApp, phone, Instagram DM or the form on this page. We will talk through your ideas and inspiration photos, then send a customised quotation.

How much does it cost?

Custom decoration experiences start at $200. Your final quotation depends on your requirements, add-ons and upgrades.

How does payment work?

A 70% deposit secures your booking once your quotation is accepted. The remaining 30% balance is due 72 hours before your event date.

Is my date confirmed when I send an inquiry?

No. Your date is secured once the quotation has been accepted and the required deposit has been received.

Can I book at short notice?

To ensure the best possible experience, we recommend booking in advance. Short-notice requests are subject to availability, so you are welcome to inquire.

What is your refund policy?

All sales are final.
